einzeiler: Kid Cudi breaks down the untold stories behind his debut album Man on the Moon.
kurzfassung: Kid Cudi reflects on the creation of his debut album, Man on the Moon: The End of Day. He shares behind-the-scenes stories about working with Kanye West, MGMT, and Ratatat. Furthermore, he discusses his journey from working at a Bape store to becoming a defining voice in hip-hop.
stichpunkte: Worked at various retail jobs in New York, including a Bape store, before launching his music career
Gained mainstream momentum after the success of his mixtape A Kid Named Cudi and a tour in Australia
Collaborated with Kanye West in Hawaii on tracks like Make Her Say, sampling an acoustic version of Lady Gaga's Poker Face
Recruited MGMT for the hook of Pursuit of Happiness after an accidental late-night studio session
Created Solo Dolo as a creepy, dark track representing a character dealing with intense internal isolation
Partnered with Chip the Ripper to represent their hometown of Cleveland on upcoming collaborative and solo projects
Designed the album packaging with illustrator Bill Sienkiewicz to evoke a rich, vintage cinematic feel
Experienced intense anxiety days before the release of Man on the Moon, which ultimately debuted to overwhelming validation

clips.hook: Choosing between a dream job and an Australian tour
clips.text: Faced with a choice between keeping a beloved retail job and embarking on an international tour, the artist chose to embrace uncertainty and pursue music.

clips.hook: Kanye West admits defeat years later
clips.text: After initially pushing for a controversial single against the artist's wishes, Kanye West eventually texted an admission that the original instinct was correct.

clips.hook: Studio session disrupted by excessive intoxication
clips.text: An attempted studio collaboration nearly stalled completely because the guest artists became overwhelmingly intoxicated and spent hours giggling at keyboard sounds.

clips.hook: Finding an artistic brother in Cleveland
clips.text: A deep friendship and creative partnership formed immediately upon meeting a fellow local artist who shared the same unique sense of humor.

clips.hook: Paralyzing anxiety right before the album drop
clips.text: In the final forty-eight hours before releasing a weird, experimental debut record, the creator suffered from severe nervous panic about potential failure.

beschreibung:
Yo, welcome back to another episode of Big Bro!

In this special episode, I share untold stories behind the creation of my debut album, Man on the Moon: The End of Day. We talk about some of the album’s most memorable collaborations from Kanye West and MGMT to Drake’s cameos in the Pursuit of Happiness video. Man on the Moon changed my life forever, and I’m excited to take you behind the scenes of the album, the people, and the stories that made it so special. Enjoy!
